# MaplibreBasemap

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

A MapLibre basemap with sky and lighting settings. Sky colors apply to mercator projection; light and atmosphere apply to globe projection.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/maplibre-basemap",
  "type": "MaplibreBasemapOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/maplibre-basemap').par.mapStyle` (an input) and `op('/maplibre-basemap').out.maplibre` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.mapStyle`, `out.maplibre`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `mapStyle` | `MapStyleField` | `"https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/dark-matter-nolabels-gl-style/style.json"` |
| `projection` | `StringLiteralField` | `"mercator"` |
| `viewState` | `CompoundPropsField` | `{"latitude":40.7128,"longitude":-74.006,"zoom":12,"pitch":0,"bearing":0}` |
| `sky` | `CompoundPropsField` | `{"enabled":false,"skyColor":"#88C6FC","horizonColor":"#ffffff","skyHorizonBlend":0.8,"atmosphereB...` |
| `light` | `CompoundPropsField` | `{"anchor":"viewport","azimuthal":210,"polar":30}` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `maplibre` | `CompoundPropsField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->

## Remarks

MaplibreBasemap describes the map under your layers: its style, its projection and the camera. It draws nothing by itself. Connect `out.maplibre` to `basemap` on [DeckRenderer](./deck-renderer.md), which receives one object holding `mapStyle`, `projection`, the camera values from `viewState`, `light` and `sky`.

`mapStyle` takes a style URL, an uploaded `.json` style file or a style object, such as the output of [MapStyleConfigurator](./map-style-configurator.md). An empty `mapStyle` turns the map off. deck.gl then draws your layers on their own, still placed by the camera values here.

The camera lives in `viewState`. Dragging the map in the editor edits a camera only when it comes from a [MapViewState](./map-view-state.md) operator: connect one to `viewState`, select that MapViewState node on its own and drag. Values typed straight into this operator's `viewState` don't change when you drag. A `viewState` connected to the DeckRenderer overrides this one.

Camera values are range-checked, and a value out of range stops the operator with an "Invalid ViewState" error rather than wrapping around. Longitude must stay within -180 to 180, which matters when you keyframe a pan across the antimeridian.

## Examples

A camera you can set by dragging the map, on a light style:

```json
{
  "nodes": [
    { "id": "/camera", "type": "MapViewStateOp", "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 }, "data": { "inputs": { "longitude": -122.42, "latitude": 37.77, "zoom": 11, "pitch": 45 } } },
    { "id": "/basemap", "type": "MaplibreBasemapOp", "position": { "x": 300, "y": 0 }, "data": { "inputs": { "mapStyle": "https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/positron-gl-style/style.json" } } },
    { "id": "/deck", "type": "DeckRendererOp", "position": { "x": 600, "y": 0 }, "data": { "inputs": {} } },
    { "id": "/out", "type": "OutOp", "position": { "x": 900, "y": 0 }, "data": { "inputs": {} } }
  ],
  "edges": [
    { "id": "/camera.out.viewState->/basemap.par.viewState", "source": "/camera", "sourceHandle": "out.viewState", "target": "/basemap", "targetHandle": "par.viewState" },
    { "id": "/basemap.out.maplibre->/deck.par.basemap", "source": "/basemap", "sourceHandle": "out.maplibre", "target": "/deck", "targetHandle": "par.basemap" },
    { "id": "/deck.out.vis->/out.par.vis", "source": "/deck", "sourceHandle": "out.vis", "target": "/out", "targetHandle": "par.vis" }
  ]
}
```
